distinctions: Identity != Party != PartyRole != Tenant != Staff record != Authorization Role
platform operator scope != tenant administrator scope
PC4 entitlement and feature availability != PC5 authorization and approval
service identity != human identity != device identity

identity.model: global authentication principal with optional explicit Party association

authentication.credential_rule: references and mechanisms are separate; secret material never exported
authentication.legacy: password hashing and JWT mechanics preserved behind compatibility path

membership.model: tenant-scoped participation with lifecycle and validity

session.model: revocable server-side session and assurance context

approval.boundary: security/control approval only; SO6 owns generalized workflow

step_up.model: expiring revocable session-scoped assurance; no provider integration

delegated_support.model: explicit permission-specific time-bound approved support or break-glass grant

audit.model: append-only safe envelope and authorized query
